items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: if I'm not mistaken, it was between him and Charlie McQuirtus who was the first color that had ever had a saxophone.

ctx.x: Was it an alto or a C melody?

It was a, I'm pretty sure it was a C melody, either alto, but I think it was a C melody. Because anyway, they was on advertisement and Clarence was playing this saxophone and Bichet was playing the clarinet and they had a piano and a wagon and they had the drum. And it was on advertisement and I was on the wagon with them and Bichet was saying he bet he could learn how to play that thing, you know. And so he was fooling around with it and fooling around with it and he blowed a couple of good notes on it and so…

I wanted to ask, before I forget it, something about those records you made. First of all, the Lee Collins records with Jones, which you made with Dave Jones too. Did you play with the band all the time at the end? Oh yeah.
